mostWorthwhile.text: Following the collagen message through protein production and secretion was most worthwhile: it connected gene expression to material the cells put outside themselves.

leastWorthwhile.text: The early signalling sequence felt less engaging because each stage offered only one combination, and the protein relays were described broadly.

surprise.text: The progression from secreted procollagen to tension-resistant fibers made the connection between a cell's protein production and tissue mechanics more concrete.

arbitrary.text: Adding hydrated proteoglycans had a clear matrix-building purpose, but their particular contribution beyond forming a water-rich gel was not very explicit.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the matrix contributes to a tissue, though the single-option sequence left limited room for meaningful choices.
